summary: A neritic tuna recorded in Malaysian waters. The Department of Fisheries lists it separately from skipjack and longtail tuna.
nativeRange: Warm Indo-West Pacific waters, including coastal islands and archipelagos.

features: Broken oblique dark stripes on the back
Dark spots between the pectoral and pelvic fins, sometimes faint
Two dorsal fins separated by a narrow gap

habitat.description: Upper coastal waters and waters around offshore islands; often schools with other mackerels and tunas.
habitat.diet: Small fish, squid, crustaceans and zooplankton.

eating: Marketed fresh, frozen, canned, dried, salted and smoked.
